manifest.description: Deterministic trace checks of agent process (stall outcomes, a test command counts only when it ran, the step's work session's own test run after its last edit, a compliance rate without the plan check unless the condition asks for a plan); a check the trace cannot decide is undetermined, never judged by a model.
